feeds.title: Toho Kingdom Blog » Kaiju Kuisine
feeds.description: Explore the wild and wacky and largely unexplored world of kaiju-related snacks and foods that have been released over the years. Get your hands on the latest Kaiju figures, statues, apparel, and more, and read honest reviews on quality, design, and overall monster-loving awesomeness. Toho Kingdom covers all media related to their copyrighted characters.

feeds.title: The Kaijuologist Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog where you can stay up to date on all news, reviews, and discussions on all things related to giant monsters in media. Read critical reviews and explore all types of monsters, themes, metaphors, and a review of the movie or other media that they were introduced to.

feeds.title: Paulkaiju
feeds.description: Paul is a designer, sculptor, and painter working away in sunny San Diego. View an amazing collection of captivating kaiju art on his blog, where monstrous creativity meets awe-inspiring imagination. Immerse yourself in the world of colossal creatures and epic battles depicted through stunning illustrations and breathtaking designs.

feeds.title: Kaiju Country
feeds.description: Enter the world of Kaijus with fan art, cosplay creations, and wild theories. Kaiju fanatic Goddenzilla shares his latest figure creations, and tells the stories and quirks behind them. Buckle up for in-depth explorations of iconic Kaiju from across film, literature, and video games.

feeds.title: Kaiju Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Unlock a fearless mindset with insights and inspiration given in the Kaiju Coaching Blog. Rick Kitagawa is an Inner Monster Wrangler. He coaches leaders and creatives to wrangle their Inner Monsters and transform them from fierce enemies to trusted confidants.

feeds.title: Tor/Forge Blog » Kaiju
feeds.description: Read posts tagged The Kaiju Preservation Society for news on Kaijus. TOR BOOKS is home to an internationally-renowned, multiple award-winning science fiction, fantasy, and horror publishing program. Tor also publishes mysteries; thrillers and suspense novels; other types of speculative fiction; movie, television, and computer game tie-in novels.

feeds.title: Kaiju Gaming Lounge
feeds.description: Kaiju Gaming Lounge is currently a group of individuals who are looking to open a premium gaming experience in Orlando Florida. Find weekly updates, major news announcements, and other Kaiju news across the globe in this space.
